subject: Coordination: severance, access shutdown, and knowledge capture for Rohan Mehta
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Notice of resignation

Mina,

I wanted to let you know that I am resigning from my role as Senior Backend Engineer. My last day will be Friday, December 11, 2026 (two weeks). I appreciate the opportunities here and I want to be helpful during the transition. I can put together a handover doc and walk whoever you assign through the main services I own.

I attached a short resignation letter for HR records. Please let me know the next steps for payroll and any exit paperwork.

Thanks,
Rohan
--
Rohan Mehta
Senior Backend Engineer, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com
Attachment: ROHAN_RESIGNATION_LETTER.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Notice of resignation

Rohan, thanks for letting us know and for offering to help with the handover. We will start the standard offboard flow and coordinate severance paperwork and access timing.

Quick next steps from HR (I):
- I'll prepare a standard severance offer for legal review and send for signature (DocuSign) by EOD tomorrow.
- Please fill out the attached knowledge transfer inventory (short CSV) with the top 6 services, runbooks, and active PRs you think should be prioritized.
- We will schedule a 60-minute exit handover call with you, Laura, and the engineer who will take ownership — possible slots for next week below.

Laura/Markus: tagging you for KG transfer plan and for review of the severance language.

Rohan, I wrote down Dec 11 as his tentative last day; confirm if you want to shorten/extend.

Best,
Mina
--
Mina Haddad
People Partner, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
Attachment: knowledge_transfer_inventory.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Notice of resignation — handover plan

Thanks, Mina. Rohan — I'm sorry to see you go, and appreciate the offered handover. Proposing this lightweight plan:

- Inventory (Rohan): complete the CSV by EOD 11/30.
- KT session (Rohan + incoming owner): 90 minutes on 12/07; agenda: architecture overview, critical incidents, deployment cadence, known gaps.
- PRs/Work in progress: list blockers and owners; try to merge any small PRs before 12/04.
- Runbook updates: mark any runbooks with last-tested date and escalate anything older than 6 months.

I'll nominate Arun Patel (eng) to take primary ownership; he'll shadow the KT session. Ben — please confirm any special credentials Arun will need to complete the work.

Laura
--
Laura Bennett
Engineering Manager, Infra
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Attachment: knowledge_transfer_inventory.csv

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Kaplan <elaine.kaplan@hrcounsel.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Notice of resignation — severance draft + legal hold question

Team,

I've drafted a standard severance offer (attached) with a two-week pay continuation + accelerated vesting of unvested RSUs as discussed. HR: please review the draft and confirm whether to include the mutual non-disparagement clause.

Two legal points to flag:
1) Legal hold — do we need to preserve any Slack/Drive content specifically tied to the incident we investigated earlier this year? If so, notify IT to prevent deletion.
2) NDA/Non-compete — Rohan's role had no customer-facing NDAs, but the standard separation paperwork includes a confidentiality reaffirmation. If external counsel (Elaine) has suggested alternate language, I'll defer.

Attaching: severance_offer_draft.docx. Mina, please coordinate getting this signed via DocuSign after HR finalizes.

-Markus
--
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
Attachment: severance_offer_draft.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Notice of resignation — access & keys

Couple of items from Security:
- We will disable non-console access (API keys, long-lived tokens) at 5pm on the last working day (12/11).
- Admin console access will be suspended 24 hours after the final day unless Legal requests preservation.
- Please provide a list of any third-party accounts Rohan has admin access to (PagerDuty, Datadog, S3 buckets). We can do a scoped token rotation for those services.

Suggested workflow: Mina to confirm final day; Laura to provide the 3rd-party list; Security will prepare a temporary access window for knowledge transfer if needed (1-2 hours on 12/07).

-Ben
--
Ben Carter
Security Operations Lead
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Coordination: severance, access shutdown, and knowledge capture — next steps

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps:  

1) Rohan, please complete the attached CSV by 11/30 EOD and confirm Dec 11 as your last day. If you prefer an earlier date, tell us today.
2) Markus: please confirm final severance language and whether we include the mutual non-disparagement clause. Once confirmed, I'll send the DocuSign link.
3) Ben: security schedule confirmed — disable non-console API keys at 5pm on 12/11; suspend admin console 12/12 unless legal holds are requested. Please prepare a 2-hour scoped access window on 12/07 for the KT call.
4) Laura: please nominate the primary successor (Arun) and share the 3rd-party app list by 12/01.
5) Exit interview + KT: scheduled tentatively 12/07 10:00–11:30 PT. Mina will send calendar invite and DocuSign link after severance sign-off.

Links: DocuSign (will be sent when draft finalized) and shared exit plan doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-exit-plan

Mina
--
Mina Haddad
People Partner, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
Attachment: final_severance_offer.pdf
